overview: The three investigators want to go on a road trip during their vacation, but just as they are about to set off, the phone rings and an unknown caller hands the trio of detectives their latest case: the archaeologists belonging to the secret society Sphinx are carrying out illegal excavations and selling the stolen art treasures. Their next target is the supposedly cursed island of Makatao.

title: Flavia
overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

title: Minamahal
overview: An introverted high school flower enthusiast tries to win the affection of a love-hating visual artist by giving her flowers during key moments of her life. The movie follows their on-and-off friendship and romance from high school up until college, when the realities of life begin to unfold.

title: Gator Face
overview: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

title: Nocturnal
overview: Min-tae, a once-notorious gangster who now leads a peaceful retired life, discovers the bloody corpse of his only next of kin: his younger brother Seok-tae. With his brother’s missing wife Moon-young as the prime suspect, Min-tae uncovers a suspicious last phone call between her and a mysterious novelist, sparking a vicious hunt for the truth despite his seemingly deceitful former crime syndicate and the police in hot pursuit.

title: Paradha
overview: A veiled village woman's life changes when city visitors challenge her traditions. As she questions customs and investigates a curse, rumors of Sati emerge, leading her to confront societal norms.

title: Duse
overview: In the years between WWI and the rise of Fascism, legendary thespian Eleonora Duse shocks everyone by getting back onstage at over 60 years of age. Struggling with the brutality of historical events unfolding and clinging to the possibility of utopia, she makes her art a revolutionary act, even at the cost of sacrificing health and affection—facing her final journey aware she could give up life itself, but not her own true nature.

title: Unexpected Family
overview: When an aging local starts to lose his memory, those around him decide to recreate an important family moment in his life for him to relive. What they discover isn't what they expect — about both themselves and about the mysterious man's past.

title: Doing Life
overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Surya Power of Love
overview: Thirty years ago, a prominent zamindar family resided in Bangalore, consisting of Maari and Dr. Mamtha. This period marked the advent of IT and biotech companies entering Bangalore, juxtaposed with the city's notorious underworld activity

title: Neglected
overview: Detective Shaw is about to retire when he finds out on his last day of work that a serial killer has buried his son alive. He then races against the clock to solve three murders and find his son’s location before he runs out of air.

title: Renner
overview: A computer genius invents an A.I life coach to help him find love, but realizes too late he accidentally programmed his manipulative mother into the code.

title: Dashing Through the Snow
overview: A US Marshal gets stuck on Christmas Eve protecting a pregnant fugitive from a bounty hunter and a hitman Santa with his henchmen of elves.

title: Apna Amitabh
overview: This is a story of a young boy named Vijay. He lives with his family in a small village named Dakita Meerganj. Vijay studies in the 9th standard of a government school. He is a huge fan of Super Star Amitabh Bachchan and always tries to behave like him. He was born in a lower cast family. And Vijay's father Anna Jamadar's profession is to clean toilet of the village. All the villagers tease Vijay by calling him after his father's profession as "Anna Safaiwale ka Beta" (cleaner's son), which he doesn't like. This film is cast cast-based political drama.

title: Ooh La La 2
overview: DNA tests before Alice and François's wedding reveal their fathers - an aristocrat and car dealer - aren't as French as they thought.

title: The Last Cabin
overview: Trapped in a remote cabin, a film crew finds themselves stalked by three masked men who know the isolated forest and their every move.

title: Teenage Wasteland
overview: Inspired by an unconventional teacher, a group of teenagers in upstate New York in the early 1990s make a student film and uncover a vast conspiracy that is poisoning their community. Thirty years later, they revisit their film and confront the legacy of this transformative experience.

title: Screw Mickiewicz 2
overview: The rebellious IIIB crew and their unconventional teacher Jan Sienkiewicz are back! Love, troubles and school dramas make up everyday life of Dante, Nel and the whole gang. It is joined now by a young mathematical genius - Korek. The guys intend to teach him how to pick up girls, but it turns out that their know-how is rather theoretical…

title: Shutter
overview: After a senior analog photographer discovers the spectral image of a former college student haunting his photos and coming to life, his girlfriend investigates the phantom, uncovering a horrific past crime that is now claiming his friends' lives one by one.

title: The Story of Everything
overview: The Story of Everything is a cinematic exploration of the cosmos that reveals the hidden hand behind our universe. From the precise laws that govern the stars to the intricate patterns found in every living cell, the film traces evidence of intentional design throughout nature. Whether examining distant star-forming clouds or the spiral structure of DNA, we discover a consistent signature woven into the fabric of existence.

title: On a Plate
overview: An ambitious young economist moves to the north of Czechia to find work. Here he meets the sons of the best meth cook, Grundza, and eventually Grundza himself, the head of the family and a caring father. The unconventional group combine progressive economic practices with street knowledge to take the family business to a whole new level.

title: Krishna Aur Chitthi
overview: What happens when the "God of Cricket" and the Lord of the Universe reside under the same roof? Krishna Aur Chitthi is a soul-stirring family drama that explores the thin line between fandom and faith, proving that when an intention is pure, every prayer, whether addressed to Vaikuntha or Wankhede, reaches the same destination

title: Jigel
overview: Jigel is a romantic comedy thriller. The hero Nandu is an expert 'locker technician' who cracks anylocker or safe in his own inimitable style. His character is very stylishly mountedwith all new and old gimmicks.

title: Mexicali
overview: A former special forces contractor is forced out of retirement as an avocado farmer in Mexico when local gangsters try to force him and his family off their farm.

title: Wild
overview: A sultry woman who charms the hearts of men in a remote province. Dolores, a devoted wife to her paraplegic husband, falls for a young mountaineer. What begins as a reckless escape turns into an affair drenched in passion and secrecy.

title: Stay
overview: Kiara, a PhD author on African spirituality, and Miles, a former MMA fighter turned trainer, facing the end of their marriage. They encounter supernatural forces and go from fighting one another to fighting for their lives. To survive, they must conquer darkness with love.

title: Bun Butter Jam
overview: Two mothers, disillusioned by failed marriages, team up to orchestrate a master plan to unite their freshman kids, Chandru and Madhu. But things get muddied when their Gen Z kids have other plans, leading to a clash of wills and generational divide.

title: Sebastian Maniscalco: It Ain't Right
overview: Filmed live at the legendary United Center arena in Chicago, Sebastian Maniscalco goes all in on family chaos, aging, and the little things that drive us all nuts—with his one-of-a-kind comedic bite.

title: Preschool
overview: Two determined fathers engage in a comical battle to enroll their kids in an elite preschool, escalating into an absurd competition with unexpected results.

title: The Musicians
overview: Astrid Thompson finally succeeds in fulfilling her father's dream: to bring together four Stradivarius for a unique concert, eagerly expected by music lovers around the world. But Lise, George, Peter and Apolline, the four virtuosos recruited for the occasion, are incapable of playing together. The rehearsals are one ego crisis after another. With no solution in sight, Astrid decides to go and find the only person who, in her eyes, can still save the event: Charlie Beaumont, the composer of the score.

title: Killbill Society
overview: As Ananda Kar returns, now as Mrityunjay Kar, truth and destiny collide in a journey of love, healing, and purpose. With its iconic music and unexpected twists, Killbill Society is set to redefine `existence` through its compelling story.

title: Kevlar Soul
overview: Brothers Alex and Robin live in miserable conditions with their violent and severely alcoholic father. In an effort to make life bearable, Alex tries to keep his father in a good mood while taking on a parental role for his younger brother, who is aggressive and unruly. When Alex falls for Ines and travels with her to Berlin, the brothers begin to drift apart, and disaster soon becomes inevitable.

title: Nilave
overview: Nilave traces the journey of Arjun, a lonely and emotionally anxious young man searching for companionship. In a world of fleeting connections, he discovers a magical love and goes to extraordinary lengths to make it eternal.

title: Close to Me
overview: Luca is a forty-year-old teacher experiencing a relationship crisis with his wife, Sara, who is much wealthier than him. During the lockdown, Luca finds himself a bystander in the life of his new neighbor, Amanda, and decides to bridge the distance between them, with disastrous consequences.

title: Situationship
overview: Three friends set out to find partners so they won’t have to go alone to their 10‑year high school reunion. Along the way, they meet a man with traditionalist views, and the story turns into a difficult confrontation between feminism and misogyny. In a world where a simple online comment can change destinies, the two sides fight without either emerging victorious.

title: Obsesyon
overview: A middle-aged woman becomes obsessed with a student, who has a crush on her stepdaughter. Every time the young man becomes intimate with the daughter, the woman fantasizes that she is with him.

title: I Love Peru
overview: In the relentless pursuit of success, a quirky actor leaves behind his closest allies. Alone facing himself, he is struck by a disturbing vision. Off to Peru for a spiritual journey.

title: Mektoub, My Love: Canto Due
overview: Amin returns to Sète after studying in Paris, still dreaming of cinema. By chance, an American producer on vacation takes an interest in his project and wants his wife, Jess, to play the lead role. But fate, whimsical as ever, has its own rules.

title: Tu Meri Poori Kahani
overview: A young star's pursuit of fame and success leads to emptiness until true love teaches the value of genuine connection over fleeting attention.

title: Ami Jokhon Hema Malini
overview: This film is a unique love story told through two parallel journeys, where "Hema Malini" is a symbol for forbidden desires. A homeopath treats a woman who introduces herself by that name, while an independent filmmaker struggles to complete a film with the same title. The two stories eventually converge, transforming their personal struggles into unconventional love stories of a kind.

title: Laila
overview: Sonu Model, a renowned beautician from the old city, is forced to disguise himself as Laila, leading to a series of comedic, romantic, and action-packed events. Chaos ensues in this hilarious laugh riot

title: A Beautiful Day
overview: Tommaso, a single father of four, has shut himself off from the world. When his daughters push him to start over, he meets Lara — a brilliant, captivating woman. But both carry secrets that could change everything.

title: A Letter to My Youth
overview: A rebellious teen and a reserved caretaker form an unlikely bond in an orphanage as they come to terms with their painful pasts.

title: Decorado
overview: Arnold, an unemployed middle-aged mouse, confides to his wife Maria that he suspects his entire world is nothing more than a set, and his life a scripted performance. When his best friend Ramiro dies under mysterious circumstances, he traces the conspiracy to a monolithic corporation whose influence reaches every corner of their daily lives.

title: Police Family
overview: At a Madurai police station, Vinoth—the son of powerful Chennai gangster Dhana—is brutally beaten by four policemen led by SI Raja and secretly dumped outside the city. The next day, he is found murdered.  Blaming the officers, Dhana unleashes ruthless revenge on them and their families. As fear and suspicion close in, SI Raja races to uncover the real killer—before Dhana’s trap destroys everything.  Who truly killed Vinoth?  What was the motive?  The shocking truth erupts in the climax.

title: Drushya Adrushya
overview: Exploring the fragile boundary between the seen and unseen, where profound secrets blur reality and deception. Features a police involvement that unravels a tangled web of hidden truths.

title: Tunnels: Sun in the Dark
overview: In 1967, as the Vietnam War raged, a Vietnamese revolutionary guerrilla team became the U.S. military's top target—charged with safeguarding a secret group of intelligence agents at all costs.

title: Harsh Couture
overview: In the campaign that could change her career as fashion influencer, Paula Pratta only needs one essential item: her son. But he trades his business school in California for a permaculture institute in Amazon. With assistant Taylor, she sets off in search of the boy and finds a world without filters and much more than she expected, including the chance to reconsider what really matters in her life.

title: Deool Band 2
overview: The story follows a farmer who decides to question and test his faith, setting off a journey filled with emotional and life-altering moments. At its core, the narrative centers on a woman who tirelessly struggles for her family, facing hardships with resilience, as her path ultimately leads her to confront the very idea of divine power

title: Stolen Time
overview: John Parker mourns the loss of his brother Pete, while Jack the Madman, driven by anger, seeks revenge. Playing with time travel has consequences. Will time heal all wounds?

title: Class Reunion
overview: Feeling nostalgic about their high school days, Hervé, Maxime, and Jordy decide to host a grand reunion party to reconnect and celebrate their 30-year graduation anniversary. However, their idealised memories clash with reality: no one wants to come, especially their former classmates Anne and Marion, who are determined to sabotage the event. For the first time, the trio face a harsh realisation – could it be that all this time they’ve been nothing but a bunch of pretentious jerks? Determined to make amends, they embark on a hilarious quest to prove to the world and themselves that they can be better men.

title: Mazaka
overview: The path to true love does not run smoothly when a father and son seek marriage at the same time.

title: Speed Demon
overview: Aboard a high-speed train, a nun who has lost her faith must perform her first exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

title: Strange Journey: The Story of Rocky Horror
overview: A wild journey into the origins of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, the biggest cult film of all time, its impact on popular culture and socio-political resonance to this day.

title: Youngblood
overview: Hockey prodigy Dean Youngblood joins the Hamilton Mustangs and has to deal with toxic behavior during his journey to the National Hockey League draft.

title: Possession of Mara
overview: After saving a mysterious woman from a suicide attempt near the Golden Gate Bridge, a young man falls in love, only to discover that she is possessed by an ancient, vengeful spirit.

title: The Academy of Fine Arts
overview: A crew of criminals execute the perfect heist, stealing a priceless liquor bottle from a notorious gang leader. But what begins as a clean getaway spirals into a storm of betrayal, bloodshed, and long-buried secrets. As the truth unravels, they discover the real battle isn't for the loot - it's for survival.

title: Thoughts & Prayers
overview: In a dystopic America, children are taught how to prepare for school shootings through elaborate drills. Yet what are intended as self-defense mechanisms are themselves deeply traumatic for students, parents, educators, and entire communities.

title: Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway
overview: When a string of deadly highway incidents begin, Conan Edogawa's investigations point towards an orchestrated plot rather than mere accidents. As he uncovers a conspiracy involving hidden identities and advanced technology, the case escalates into a high-speed race against time to stop a calculating mastermind before more lives are lost.

title: Follow
overview: Sebastián, a charismatic con artist who seduces women to steal their money, puts his retirement plans on hold after the sudden appearance of Carolina, an enigmatic woman who will expose him to the greatest danger of his career.

title: Hidden Murder
overview: Eva is in a happy moment of her life with her new partner, Nazario, and his daughter Alicia. But an encounter with her ex, José, opens the door to complicated situations that will send her on a journey of fear that has terrible consequences for everyone. Nothing is what it seems.

title: Everybody Loves Me When I'm Dead
overview: Two bank employees steal from a dead woman's account and unwittingly entangle themselves in Pattaya's criminal underworld.

title: Rocky El Ghalaba
overview: After being threatened by a rival who wants to steal his latest project, a successful tech innovator hires an enthusiastic but inexperienced bodyguard.

title: Messenger
overview: After a heartbreak, engineer Sakthi attempts suicide but is saved by messages from Anandhi, a deceased Facebook friend. He falls in love with her spirit and marries her, until she threatens to leave, testing their supernatural bond.

title: Hitman 2
overview: After a successful first season, Webtoon "Assassin Jun" is about to begin it's second season. Out of ideas, Jun uses an anonymous email's plot in his Webtoon, only to see real-life terrorist attacks resembling the story unfold.

title: Stone Creek Killer
overview: A small-town police chief pursues a serial killer, helped by a psychic's visions, while fighting to prove his own innocence.

title: Macbeth: David Tennant & Cush Jumbo
overview: Fearless and unforgettably creepy. This high-concept production, filmed live at London’s Donmar Warehouse, stars the formidable talents of David Tennant and Cush Jumbo in Shakespeare’s most infamous tragedy.

title: Double Occupancy
overview: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

title: Majhi Prarthana
overview: Set in British-era rural Maharashtra, Majhi Prarthana – Akalpaniya Prem Katha is a heart-wrenching tale of unimaginable love. Golya and Prarthana’s love blooms like a wildflower amidst thorns and they find solace in each other’s hearts, shining brighter than the stars. But as their love deepens, a dark force rises —an unrelenting shadow of power and betrayal determined to crush their dreams. Will their love withstand the storm and carve its name into history, or will it be lost in the abyss of fate?

title: Wait for Me to be Successful Later
overview: Facing constant ridicule from his successful relatives every Eid, an unemployed man desperately races to secure a job before the 2026 family gathering to save his dignity and support his struggling family.

title: Pyar Mei Qurban
overview: Pyar Mei Qurban is an Indian Hindi Language film, directed by Zuber K Khan. The film features Zuber K Khan, Imtiyaz Bhat, Ebadat Bhat and Roma Arora in lead.

title: Agnyathavasi
overview: In 1997, a rural police inspector leads a simple life until a crime occurs at his quiet village outpost after 25 years. His investigation uncovers long-buried secrets in the town.

title: Pade Akasha
overview: The story is inspired by Dr. Sruti Mohapatra, a courageous woman from Odisha in a wheelchair. An IAS qualifier, she lost her job due to disability but never gave up, becoming a powerful social activist and inspiring many with her resilience.

title: Back to the 90s
overview: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

title: 2020 Delhi
overview: 2020 Delhi, India's first one-shot feature, inspired by anti-CAA protests, the 2020 Delhi riots, and the conspiracies surrounding them, while also highlighting the plight of Hindu minorities in Pakistan and Bangladesh. a story of survival.

title: Human Resource
overview: Working in HR at a challenging company, Fren interviews young new hires and is secretly one month pregnant, grappling with the decision to have a child in difficult circumstances.

title: Starbright
overview: A young woman becomes the guardian of a fallen star, which she must protect from dangerous forces with the help of a brave stranger.

title: Onlyfangs
overview: A wannabe monster hunter helps a bloodthirsty gang of vampire chicks expand their business by creating a new app to turn their victims into customers.

title: Seat Edge
overview: A YouTube star fakes ghost-hunting videos with CGI until his lies are exposed. To regain his fame, he enters a real ghost town, turning his stunt into a terrifying fight for survival.

title: Loner
overview: Loner follows an aspiring vlogger who retreats to an isolated cabin deep in the wilderness to rebuild his fractured sense of self, only to discover an ancient force lurking in the surrounding forest. As strange phenomena begin to escalate, his attempt at solitude spirals into a terrifying descent into paranoia and survival.  Directed by filmmaker duo Charlie Robb and Douglas Tawn, the film blends psychological horror, wilderness dread, and found-footage-style realism against the bleak backdrop of the British countryside. Debuting as a FoundTV exclusive, Loner delivers a slow-burning nightmare rooted in isolation, nature, and the fear of the unknown.

title: Yogi Da
overview: It is story about a Honest and straightforward lady police Inspector Yogi works in Coimbatore, where she proves a textile mill owner’s “suicide” is actually a murder by his own son, leading to her transfer to the punishment area Vyasarpadi in North Chennai. There she confronts ruthless don Shekar Babu, who controls the area and its police through fear, power, and political influence, but Yogi refuses to bow down and begins taking action against his network.

title: Our Land
overview: In 2009, a man and two accomplices try to evict members of the Indigenous community of Chuschagasta in northern Argentina. Claiming ownership of the land and armed with guns, they kill the community’s leader, Javier Chocobar. The murder is caught on video. It takes nine years of protests before court proceedings are finally opened in 2018. During all this time, the killers remain free. The film combines the voices and photographs of the community with courtroom footage to explore the long history of colonialism and land dispossession that led to this crime.

title: Hysteria
overview: A film shoot takes a dark turn when the burning of a Quran throws the crew into turmoil. Caught in accusations, intern Elif is drawn into a dangerous game of secrets and lies, finding herself at the heart of an all-absorbing conspiracy.

title: Host
overview: Ing is sent to Pinijkhun Reform School, an all-girls facility on a remote island. The only rule here is that everyone must obey orders.

title: Last Days
overview: Determined to fulfill his life’s mission, 26-year-old John Allen Chau embarks on a dangerous adventure across the globe to convert the uncontacted tribe of North Sentinel Island to Christianity, while a detective from the Andaman Islands races to stop him before he does harm to himself or the tribe.

title: Jacker 3: Road to Hell
overview: Jacker and Gloria return to unveil the origins of Jacker's nature.

title: 10 giorni con i suoi
overview: After the phenomenal success of the first two films, “When Mom is Away” and “When Mom is Away… With the Family,” the adventures of the Rovelli family continue! This time, they’re heading to Puglia, where their eldest daughter, Camilla, is moving to attend university with her boyfriend, Antonio.

title: Ambalamukkile Visheshangal
overview: In a Kerala village, jobless Pappu juggles clearing his academic backlogs, wooing his crush, and dealing with family troubles amid local mayhem

title: Son of Muthanna
overview: A father who served in the army shares a deep loving connection with his son.

title: Mob Cops
overview: A retired NYPD detective writes a book about his family's ties to the mob, igniting a firestorm between the corrupt cops working for the city's brutal crime boss and the officers trying to bring them to justice.

title: Terror Comes Knocking: The Marcela Borges Story
overview: Marcela Borges and her growing family’s idyllic weekend quickly turn into every family’s worst nightmare when masked gunmen barge into their Florida suburban home. With gunshots piercing their walls, a newly pregnant Marcela, her husband, and their young son are left with no choice but to comply with their captors’ demands: surrender $200,000 or their lives. But with no means of accessing that sort of money, Marcela faces insurmountable odds to protect her family from their violent captors and must make the life and death decisions to keep her family safe.

title: Afterlight
overview: In a future shaped by war, AI, and fractured timelines, five sci-fi stories explore humanity’s fight for connection, survival, and meaning across time and space.

title: Catli
overview: In the early 1980s, Abdullah Catli becomes entangled in an international conflict spanning several European countries. As Europe turns into a stage for covert confrontations, Catli is increasingly faced with existential decisions. Caught between loyalty, responsibility, and the protection of his family, an intense drama unfolds about guilt, loss, and survival.

title: Men at Work 3
overview: A worker from the company 'Onze Jongens', which has gone back to normal handyman work, sees an opportunity to get out of debt.

title: 40 Seconds
overview: It explores the tragic events leading up to the murder of 21-year-old Willy Monteiro Duarte, highlighting the intertwining of chance encounters, rivalries, and latent tensions.

title: Lovesick
overview: A love story that starts with pretending to be sick, describing a troubled teenager named Ye Zijie who always loves to get into trouble. By chance, he discovered that "it's good to be sick".

title: My Best Friend
overview: Facing menopause and empty-nest anxiety, friends Julia and Clara decide to travel together to visit their daughters who are on an exchange program abroad.

title: Folktales
overview: On the precipice of adulthood, teenagers converge at a traditional folk high school in Arctic Norway. Dropped at the edge of the world, they must rely on only themselves, one another, and a loyal pack of sled dogs as they all grow in unexpected directions.

title: Timeless Tidings of Joy
overview: Ally, inherits Timeless Tidings, a shop her grandmother, Joy, opened in the 1940s to sell her handmade letter-press tidings. The shop was a labor of love, service, and sacrifice throughout the decades for Joy. Ally always saw Joy’s sacrifices for the shop as a burden on Joy’s life and happiness. When Ally returns to the shop to prepare it for sale, she meets Bennett, an old soul, who wants to preserve her Grandma Joy’s legacy. As Ally and Bennett navigate the next steps, divine intervention forces them both to take a new, or rather old look at the fate of the shop and themselves.

title: Breaking Walls
overview: In the late 1980s, in a working-class neighborhood on the outskirts of Bilbao, Basque Country, Spain. A girls' rhythmic gymnastics team has the opportunity to compete in a tournament in Berlin; but since the girls' mothers cannot take time off work, it is the fathers who must accompany them on the trip.

title: The Book of Sijjin and Illiyyin
overview: As a child, Yuli witnessed her parents die at the hands of a mysterious force after her mother became possessed. Branded a cursed and unwanted child, she survived and grew up under the roof of her father's other wife Ambar and her daughter Laras, enduring constant humiliation. Fueled by vengeance, Yuli performs a forbidden ritual. As the dark magic takes root, the world around her begins to unravel.

title: Mumu
overview: Deaf Xiao Ma and his daughter Mumu rely on each other for companionship. The little "big sister" Mumu serves as the family's pillar—bridging communication between her father and the outside world, helping him secure work and earn a living. However, as Mumu grows older, she must integrate into the hearing world, and their inseparable life is about to be disrupted. Just then, a criminal syndicate that specifically preys on the deaf sets its sights on Xiao Ma. Desperate to protect his daughter, he is gradually lured step by step into the abyss of crime...

title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: A Lonely Dragon Wants to Be Loved
overview: Miss Kobayashi, Tohru, Ilulu, and Kanna’s peaceful lives are shaken when Kanna’s father, Kimun Kamui, forces her to return to the Dragon World. As a war brews between the Chaos and Harmony factions, Kanna tries to unite the two worlds, torn between her friends and father. When dragons clash, Ilulu uncovers a hidden force manipulating the war. Can they stop the war before it consumes both worlds?

title: Are We Good?
overview: This raw, intimate portrait of comedian and podcast pioneer Marc Maron follows the sudden loss of his partner and filmmaker Lynn Shelton. Maron struggles with grief, disillusionment, and a shifting comedy landscape, processing it all through his life, both on-stage and off.

title: Sree Ayyappan
overview: Lord Ayyappa takes human form to stop terrorists targeting a major temple. The National Anti-Terrorist Squad and Indian Army launch a joint operation to counter the planned attack.

title: Untamable
overview: In Yaounde, Police Chief Billong is investigating the murder of a police officer. In the streets and at home, he struggles to maintain order. A man of principle and tradition, he is reaching breaking point.

title: All That We Never Were
overview: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

title: Udaala
overview: In Bijapur,an orphaned auto driver falls in love and follows a girl into college,where playful revenge against bullies takes many twists—yet can the wisdom of the city’s monuments turn conflict into love,respect,and harmony?

title: Justice for Jeni
overview: Jeni and priyanka are best friends andambitious medical students with dreams of making a difference in the world.their bond is unbreakable. however, their lives take a tragic turn when jenigets brutally raped and dies unexpectedly. devastated by the loss, priya isconsumed by grief and anger. she decides to seek justice for her friend'suntimely death. as she navigates the complex legal process, she becomesincreasingly disillusioned with the system and status quo.

title: Jerry West: The Logo
overview: He built dynasties, broke barriers, and became the silhouette that defines the game. But beneath Jerry West's legendary NBA legacy was a man haunted by perfection and pain. Through rare interviews with family and basketball icons, uncover the complex truth behind The Logo.

title: Kadhal Kadhai Sollava
overview: This story tells about "Micheal And Shreya" who participate in the Program , which Actor Vijaysethupathi Conducts through FM "Kadhal Kadhai Sollava"

title: Dastaar
overview: A Sikh immigrant rises from newcomer to community leader following a devastating racist attack.

title: Kika
overview: While pregnant with her second child, Kika faces the sudden death of her partner. Totally heartbroken, and broke, she sets her priorities straight : 1.⁠ ⁠make money fast 2.⁠ ⁠stay strong. Dirty underwear, dildos and neurotic parents will unexpectedly help.

title: The Creeps
overview: When a mysterious gateway between dimensions unleashes a horde of nasty little creatures into Vuokatti Ski Resort, Zach and his friends’ dream holiday takes a turn for the terrifying. What was supposed to be an epic party—filled with sex, drugs, rock ’n’ roll, and Hollywood legend Christopher Lambert—spirals into pure chaos as the Creeps run wild. Now, Zach must rise to the occasion, battle the pint-sized terrors, and prove that being a hero isn’t so different from the ‘80s movies he worships.

title: The Man with Glasses
overview: The Man with the Glasses is the story of a man named Halim Rahayyah, who cleans the park's restrooms. After being fired for charging people, his protest is recorded and widely viewed on social media. The police arrest him, and in prison he realizes that he bears a striking resemblance to a terrorist wanted by the Pentagon named Wolf, a terrorist who has a $30,000 reward for his capture. This resemblance gets him involved in strange and adventurous adventures, to the point where even his father decides to turn him in for the reward...

title: Aghosham
overview: When a serious incident puts a university and its students at risk, a stoic lecturer devises a plan to protect them.

title: The Bose Files: Sach Ya Sazish
overview: Veerali joins Anuj, a researcher obsessed with uncovering the truth behind Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's mysterious disappearance, exposing evidence that challenges the official story of his death.

title: Free Fall: Who You Are
overview: Marc’s world unravels when a secret affair with fellow officer Kay forces him to choose between the life he built and the truth he can no longer deny. Free Fall – Who You Are is a reimagined recut of the 2013 cult film Freier Fall. Expanding beyond a coming-out story, Free Fall - Who You Are asks a deeper question: what happens when an honest life truly begins?

title: Enigma
overview: Two legends contested their identities as women in the court of public opinion: April Ashley, who was immortalized as a trailblazer by embracing her transgender history; and Amanda Lear, who has consciously denied and obfuscated her history for decades. Their divergent paths reveal disparate but intertwined legacies.

title: Wormtown
overview: One year into a plague of flesh-eating, mind-altering worms, the nocturnal town of Ashland, Ohio, has embraced the parasites’ rule. Under cult-like Mayor Joshua, zealous Ranchers spread their gospel—by persuasion or by force. A trio of uninfected women cling to survival through scavenging, extreme hygiene, and evasion. But everyone breaks eventually, unleashing betrayal, sacrilege, and body horror.

title: Behind the Curtain: Stranger Things - The First Shadow
overview: Go behind the scenes with the cast and crew of “Stranger Things: The First Shadow”, the award-winning live stage show that expands the Hawkins universe.

title: Lake George
overview: Four years after a heist gone wrong, two childhood friends, Rio and Psych, are thrust into a high-stakes journey. When Psych discovers his imprisoned father is being held for ransom with only 24 hours to pay $100,000, the pair embarks on a desperate mission to secure the funds.

title: Zodiac Killer Project
overview: Against the backdrop of deserted spaces, a filmmaker explores his abandoned Zodiac Killer documentary, delving into the true crime genre's inner workings at a saturation point.

title: Rally from Paris to the Pyramids
overview: This action-packed adventure for family audiences follows Reodor Felgen, a brilliant but eccentric inventor, and his two unlikely friends — Solan, a daring magpie, and Ludvig, a timid hedgehog — as they attempt to redeem themselves by competing in the legendary Paris-to-the-Pyramids rally. Equipped with their extraordinary racecar, Il Tempo Gigante, the trio embarks on a high-stakes journey through bustling Paris, the perilous Italian Alps, and the scorching Egyptian desert. With their home, friendship, and lives on the line, they must prove that ingenuity and determination can conquer any challenge.  A thrilling follow-up to The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix

title: Jai
overview: The protagonist Sathya from Simhabettu finds himself in a dilemma after he finds out the truth behind the people he trusted the most.

title: Amrutanjan
overview: One mad father, one fearless son, unlimited friendship, and a love story that turns life upside down. This roller-coaster of laughter and emotion delivers nonstop entertainment.

title: Batya 2. Ded
overview: On the verge of divorce, Max comes to his ex Irina's to pick up his son Dima for the autumn holidays, but then it turns out that the child has run away from home. The worried parents set off in search in the car of family psychologist/Irina's part-time boyfriend Vlad. Learning that Dima ran away to the village to Max's father, Bata, Max recalls, on the drive, how his parents, during their divorce, sent him to the village, about their life together, his first love and childhood friends.

title: The Sun Rises on Us All
overview: He sacrificed himself for love, taking the blame for a crime she committed. Unable to repay him for the sacrifice he made, she leaves to start a new life. Many years later, the former lovers meet again, but their estranged yet intertwined daily lives gradually unveil their tragic past. While one of them seeks redemption, the other yearns for release. In a painful and final farewell, they awaken from their wandering for one last heart-wrenching embrace.

title: Montreal, My Beautiful
overview: At 53 years old, Feng Xia, a Chinese immigrant in Montreal, finally confronts her repressed desire for women and begins a secret affair with a young Québécoise.

title: Red Code Blue
overview: Young police detective Romāns Skulte joins the Riga Central Precinct in the mid-1990s. In no time at all, Skulte’s youthful enthusiasm clashes with the harsh reality of the streets, leading him to the realisation that in order to purge the city of crime, ethical and legal boundaries must be breached.

title: Erken Kis
overview: Ferhat (49), a factory manager in Istanbul, and Handan (45), a bank manager, decide to have a child through surrogacy with Lia (28), a young artist of Georgian and Ukrainian descent. Shortly after their daughter Ada (1) is born, war breaks out between Russia and Ukraine. As a result, Lia is forced to stay in Istanbul with Ferhat and Handan for a while longer. Believing that surrogacy is the formula that will take her to Europe, Lia does not want to leave Ada.

title: Josephine
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault in Golden Gate Park, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice, and a way to feel safe again.

title: Ice Beast
overview: When a young girl goes out to search for her missing grandfather, the cold is not the only thing she has to survive. As night falls and the snow closes in, she begins to realize she is not alone and whatever is out there has been waiting.

title: Idols
overview: A fiery young motorcycle racer throws away his shot at the junior championship in a reckless crash, only to receive a surprise offer from a top Moto2 team that gives him a chance at redemption. But to claim it, he must train under his estranged father, a disgraced former world champion haunted by a tragic past. As the father and son battle personal demons, media scrutiny, and a ruthless racing circuit, their fractured bond is pushed to the limit by ambition, love, and the unforgiving speed of the sport. With a wildcard entry into MotoGP on the line, they must confront the wreckage of their relationship to seize a future—on and off the track.

title: The Travellers
overview: Stephen Seary, a stage designer, returns to Australia to visit his dying mother, but a quick trip descends into family tensions, past conflicts, and romantic complications, jeopardizing his return to Europe and the opera that awaits.

title: Mother's Baby
overview: A woman navigates the complex journey of motherhood while confronting her deepest fears and anxieties.

title: Hi Zindagi
overview: A youth-centric drama following four modern young women in metro cities as they navigate work, relationships, and changing ideas of independence.

title: Shaila
overview: ‘SHAILA’ is a Hindi-language musical romance film produced by SUNIL SHARMA and written and directed by SAKI SHAH. The film star Rohit Choudhary and Sara Khan as Kunal and Shaila. Its an emotional journey that captures the essence of finding love in most unexpected places. ‘SHAILA’ takes you on an emotional journey through love's tender moments and heart-wrenching trials, set against the stunning backdrop of one of the world's most beautiful regions.

title: The Secret of Women
overview: A wealthy executive and a struggling artist encounter a mysterious drifter whose presence forces them to face buried truths and reshape their lives.

title: Horror in the High Desert 4: Majesty
overview: On a desolate Nevada ranch, a woman uncovers a long-buried box. What's inside begins to expose a terrifying history she was never meant to find.

title: Halgat
overview: Halgat is the story of a community based outside a village, where all the people mostly live by stealing and looting from nearby villages.

title: Abduct
overview: A woman's peaceful mountain getaway takes a bizarre turn when her boyfriend disappears, and a random naked man shows up claiming to be him.

title: Joe Speedboot
overview: After a bizarre accident leaves Fransje Hermans in a wheelchair, he seems doomed to live out his days in the sluggish village of Lomark. The accident leaves him unable to move or speak, and with the exception of one functional arm, his life seems hopeless. All that changes when charismatic newcomer Joe Speedboot arrives and forms an unlikely friendship with Fransje.

title: No Good Men
overview: 2021, Afghanistan right before the Taliban’s return. Naru, the only camerawoman at Kabul’s main TV station, struggles to keep custody of her three-year-old son after leaving her serial cheater husband. Convinced no good men exist in her country, Naru is caught off guard when Qodrat, Kabul TV’s most important journalist, gives her a career opportunity. As the two crisscross the city reporting on its last days of freedom, sparks fly and Naru starts to doubt herself: could there actually be a good man out there?

title: The Boy from Below
overview: On Halloween night, 1997, a masked killer brings slasher films to life in Carpenter Falls. A video store clerk and her friends must survive his deadly game before they’re picked off one by one.

title: Refuge
overview: Four estranged friends reunite on a fishing trip, but a missing child and a desperate father's accusation turn reunion into a deadly reckoning

title: Manada Kadalu
overview: "Manada Kadalu" is a coming-of-age love story. Sumukha, an MBBS dropout, pursues love interest Rashika. However, friend Anjali's influence leads him to self-discovery and reevaluating life's value.

title: Snakes and Ladders: Childish Actions
overview: Ahmed meets Malak, and their relationship quickly evolves from mere admiration to mutual love. Each seeks to impress the other with their personality and actions, hoping their love story lasts forever and withstands all challenges.

title: Charak
overview: The disappearance of two children creates tension in a village, as locals suspect the involvement of a nearby ascetic tribe.

title: Leanne Morgan: Unspeakable Things
overview: Leanne Morgan discusses her rise to fame, family matters, and her one-time CBD experience.

title: Whisper My Name
overview: It’s Ziba’s birthday… For a teenage, student working girl, living in a dormitory, with no bonds to her parents, it is a dream to move to a room of her own. She’s struggling to find a path to be independent, but everything becomes even more complicated when her dad, Khosro, shows up. He has escaped from a psychiatric hospital to celebrate the special day with his daughter…

title: Tula Pahata
overview: A music composer and a chess grandmaster choose to live together despite societys expectations, but their lives take an unexpected turn when their families meet and hidden truths begin to surface. Spanning three generations, the story explores love, emotions, and changing family relationships.

title: The Whisper
overview: Fleeing from their violent father, siblings Lucía and Adrián take refuge in a remote mansion. With the help of a hidden micro-camera on a cat, Lucía uncovers a terrifying secret: their neighbors are part of a criminal network that kidnaps teenage girls to make snuff films, and they intend to get rid of the siblings. As Lucía fights to protect her brother, she must face a dark family curse that follows them into their newfound sanctuary.

title: Jalan Pulang
overview: After her husband's mysterious death, Lastini believes a dark entity is possessing her daughter, Arum. With only five days before Arum's leap-year birthday, Lastini and her two other children journey across Java to seek help from spiritual healers. As the demon's grip tightens, they race against time to save Arum and find their way back home.

title: Paris Cafe
overview: Olivizhiyaal, from the u.s., dreams of introducing her soulmate kavinSamson, a phd scholar, to the two people she admires most — her parents inIndia. She wants to share a happy news to them. But her smile fades when she learns that her parents, dr. Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. A photograph in a paris café that brings thePast crashing back. What did dr. Gautam do? Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?

title: Red Silk
overview: 1927. Trans-Siberian Express. Secret documents that will determine the future of the USSR and China are being transported across Russia. Under the guise of ordinary passengers, foreign intelligence officers and real thugs are hiding, ready to do anything for the sake of documents. A young Red Army soldier and a former Tsarist agent have to team up to uncover a common enemy.

title: And the Rest Will Follow
overview: Famous film director Levent (45), the honorary guest of Soke Film Festival from Istanbul, is completely unaware of Aliye (25), a housekeeper at the hotel where he is staying. However, Aliye, who is trying to tailor a new life story for herself, knows Levent and his films very well. Aliye's intriguing story brings together these two distant people with completely different lives. Now, they have to choose between reality and fiction.

title: Sarala Subbarao
overview: A romantic family drama set in 1970s Mysore that portrays the journey of Sarala and Subbarao as they balance love, tradition, and aspirations.

title: Ikk Kudi
overview: In a family where love stories always end in heartbreak, Simis arranged marriage is seen as a longoverdue new beginning. Her fiancé is charming, successful, and everything her parents hoped for. But just days before the wedding, a whisper of doubt creeps into Simi’s mind — and it refuses to leave.

title: Jurassic Reborn
overview: When cutting-edge research leads to the creation of living dinosaurs, a team of scientists on a secluded island must risk their lives and confront the now-growing creatures to prevent the animals from escaping and attacking the mainland.

title: The Man I Love
overview: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

title: Die'ced: Reloaded
overview: Benny escapes an asylum on Halloween, masked as a scarecrow and hungry for blood. In 1980s Seattle, the hunt is on - and no one is safe.

title: Risque
overview: Fired from a strip club, a vengeful dancer masterminds a high-stakes heist with fellow strippers to take down the corrupt boss and the men who underestimate them.

title: Hands
overview: In a world of elite underground fighters, a couple tries to prove they are the best against a greedy rival and a merciless hired gun. They soon have to choose between winning and vengeance.

title: Gadhi
overview: Ajay and Anjali were in love. Their friend was Bablu. An uncle and aunty known to Bablu were going to their hometown and gave the house keys to Bablu before leaving. Bablu gave those keys to Ajay.

title: The Unrestricted War
overview: A top-tier Canadian virologist and his Chinese wife are suddenly arrested by military secret agents in Beijing. He is threatened with the task of stealing a sample of his own work from his former laboratory, and the situation rapidly turns worse when people begin to fall ill.

title: The Random Guest
overview: A lonely wife who can't seem to get her busy husband's attention falls for a man who stays in the same guest house. What she doesn't realize is that he set out to be there not for her.

title: Run
overview: When Melissa leaves her fiancé Andre at the altar, her best friends convince her to go to a Cabin in the woods on a much needed “Girls Trip” to get her mind off things. But things take a huge turn when their friend Jenny is found mutilated in the middle of the woods. When the news announces an all out Alien attack on the Nation, the girls will now have to try their best to survive.

title: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
overview: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.

title: Vaibhavam
overview: Vaibhav, a righteous young man with entrepreneurial dreams, finds himself entwined in a profound mosaic of love, family, and friendships.

title: Love Guru
overview: Sophia, a talented architect has been dreaming of marrying her true love. But when a new man walks into her life, everything changes. Torn between family expectations and the stirrings of her heart, Sophia embarks on a journey of self-discovery, love, and difficult choices.

title: Mercy
overview: On the eve of Christmas, Shekhar is faced with the life-altering predicament of having to end life support for his sick mother. His decision permanently alters his relationship with his family and changes him forever.

title: Paper Tiger
overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

title: Anbe Diana
overview: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.

title: A Cherry Pie Christmas
overview: An ambitious pastry chef returns to her small-town roots in Door County, WI, and, over the holidays, needs to decide between her career dreams and her family’s struggling orchard business.

title: Manav Market
overview: A woman’s disappearance leads a simple man into the dark underbelly of the medical world. When Kajal vanishes after returning to the city, Ishwar’s search pulls him into a massive hospital where he uncovers brutal scams and the ruthless exploitation of patients. What begins as a personal quest turns into a dangerous battle against a powerful, corrupt healthcare system — and a fight to save both Kajal and countless innocent lives.

title: Idi Mazha Kaattu
overview: A migrant counselor's life takes an unexpected turn when she joins four unusual patients on a transformative journey through Kerala, blending elements of adventure and social commentary.

title: Frozen Hot Boys
overview: Driven by her personal agenda, a teacher at a juvenile detention center convinces a crew of teenage misfits to enter an snow sculpting contest in Japan.

title: The Fakenapping
overview: Failed entrepreneur and struggling dad Sattam finds himself tangled in a madcap scheme when he decides to repay his debts — by kidnapping his own father.

title: Phool Pishi O Edward
overview: In a zamindar household, a watchful aunt becomes the quiet witness to a mystery that slowly exposes injustice.

title: Never Blink
overview: Five medical students discover a way to capture what you can't see when you blink and the results are terrifying. A frightening journey into the macabre world that will make you never blink again. In a blink of an eye, you will die.

title: Wild Horse Nine
overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

title: Flores para Antonio
overview: A daughter sets out to find out the truth about the man who was her father, a legendary musician, who died when she was 8 years old. He is Antonio Flores, and she the also famous actress Alba Flores. Alba stopped singing when she lost Antonio and is now determined to recover her voice and her background, asking family members and friends for the first time.

title: Planet Single: Greek Adventure
overview: A Greek getaway for five friends turns into a hilarious detective story when suspicions rise around one of their partners — who may be a famous con-man.

title: Love+War
overview: Pulitzer Prize-winning conflict photojournalist Lynsey Addario reflects on a career working in some of the world's most dangerous war zones, including the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

title: Birthrite
overview: When a pregnant woman is bequeathed a home from an estranged aunt, she and her girlfriend leave the city behind to begin new chapter. But when a karmic debt threatens the life of their unborn child, they soon discover their place in the cursed history of the town.

title: Papa Zola: The Movie
overview: Papa Zola and his gifted daughter Pipi embark on everyday adventures that highlight their close bond and her quick wit.

title: National Theatre Live: The Importance of Being Earnest
overview: Being sensible can be excessively boring. At least Jack thinks so. While assuming the role of dutiful guardian in the country, he lets loose in town under a false identity. Meanwhile, his friend Algy takes on a similar facade. Unfortunately, living a double life has its drawbacks, especially when it comes to love. Hoping to impress two eligible ladies, the gentlemen find themselves caught in a web of lies they must carefully navigate.

title: National Theatre Live: Inter Alia
overview: Jessica Parks is a smart Crown Court Judge at the top of her career. Behind the robe, she is a karaoke fiend, loving wife and a supportive parent. When an event threatens to throw her life completely off balance, can she hold her family upright?

title: Cristina Kathirvelan
overview: Kathirvelan is in love with Cristina . Both are give their documents to the witnesses for the registered marriage of the sister of the rowdy. In it, the hero and heroine who gave the documents to the witnesses receive a wrong marriage certificate as if they were married. The heroine Cristina is engaged to marry a stranger. Kathir fights and join.

title: Vishnu Vinyasam
overview: A superstitious man confronts his deepest convictions when he discovers that the woman he has fallen for has a dark secret.

title: Facing War
overview: Jens Stoltenberg had planned to step down after nine years in the powerful position of NATO Secretary General. The 65-year-old politician had packed his bags to go home to his wife in Norway, as he had promised her. But then Joe Biden called and asked him to stay another year. Because in a troubled world, an experienced leader is needed more than ever. With unprecedented access, we follow Jens Stoltenberg through his last year as Secretary General of NATO.

title: The Dumpling Queen
overview: A biographical drama of Znag Jianhe, a woman who left her home in China for Hong Kong, where she eventually founded the renowned Chinese frozen dumpling company Wanchai Ferry.

title: Worth the Wait
overview: A group of strangers' lives fatefully intertwine as they navigate budding love, confront profound loss, and encounter old flames.

title: Dead Lover
overview: A lonely gravedigger who stinks of corpses finally meets her dream man, but their whirlwind affair is cut short when he tragically drowns at sea. Grief-stricken, she goes to morbid lengths to resurrect him through madcap scientific experiments, resulting in grave consequences and unlikely love.

title: Smothered
overview: After surviving a severe accident with lingering amnesia, a micro-painting artist begins to suspect that the woman who visits claiming to be his mother is actually a dangerous stranger.

title: Jetlee
overview: An attendant on a flight from Dubai to Kochi gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

title: Sandbag Dam
overview: A story about a forbidden love set in a village threatened by swollen rivers. Upon his return home for his father’s funeral, Slaven revives his relationship with his childhood friend, a young sportsman named Marko, his teenage love, and the reason his father kicked him out of the house. Now tempted to reunite, they need to make peace with their own decisions and struggle against the family restraints.

title: Main Actor Nahin Hoon
overview: A frustrated actor in Mumbai connects with a retired banker in Frankfurt through an online audition and ends up teaching him acting over video calls. Their sessions unfold across two cities, pushing both to confront buried emotions and truths they have long avoided.

title: Water Park Shark
overview: Sharks breach a seaside water park during the debut of a new ride, forcing a lifeguard and the town’s police chief to contain the chaos and protect guests from becoming prey.

title: Lenin Pandiyan
overview: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district. By the orders from a steadfast judge, to ensure protection & safeguard them from the vindictive political system, they nominate a weakest unassuming rookie police constable .The emotional bond between the rookie policeman and the couple & how they avenge the entrenched political system with fortuitous incidents as a new found allies forms the rest of the narrative.

title: Golpes
overview: Fresh from prison in 1980s Spain, Migueli reunites his gang for heists to settle past debts. His brother Sabino, now a cop assigned to the case, knows his methods - but Migueli won't stop until he reaches his goal.

title: Union County
overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

title: Re/Member: The Last Night
overview: Three years after completing a deadly game, high schoolers trapped in a looping nightmare must survive brutal encounters and unravel a terrifying curse.

title: Diabolical: The Epstein Files
overview: It's the scandal that has shocked Americans and rocked the Trump administration. A legal and political saga that has shattered fundamental beliefs that all are equal in the eyes of the law. What do the Epstein Files reveal?

title: Better Class
overview: When middle-class parents Alicia and Gonzalo get their son Fer into an elite secular school, their quest to secure his future quickly exposes their own deep desire for upper-class status, wealth, and social prestige.

title: Super Hit
overview: The film is a chaotic, comedic road trip that begins when a journalist disappears, sparking rumors involving "Big Brothers". Satya (Gowrav Shetty) impulsively takes a car, only for Madhu (Shwetha V) to jump in while fleeing goons. A masked man, Munna Bhai (Gilli Nata), joins them later, turning the journey into an unpredictable adventure filled with eccentric characters. The story blends comedy, light romance, and crime, ultimately concluding with a courtroom scene.

title: Paternal Leave
overview: Torn between longing and anger, 15-year-old Leo travels to the coast of northern Italy to meet her biological father. The two are complete strangers to each other. They struggle to find truth, affinity, love and the courage to face themselves.

title: Seemingly Perfect Family
overview: Inspired by true events. When 18-year-old Lexi ages out of the foster care system and lies to get an au pair job, the dream family she is working for turns out to be a nightmare as she uncovers their twisted secrets. Rylee Reagan stars.

title: Voyna i muzyka
overview: The war burst into the peaceful life of three friends suddenly, forever changing their destinies. Each of them went to the front, leaving the most valuable things at home in order to fight for this most valuable thing. Surprisingly, they are helped to survive in this fiery hell of battles with fascism, music. Taking musical instruments with them, friends play to maintain the morale of fellow soldiers, as well as to compose the leitmotif of Victory so desired by all.

title: Sweetheart!
overview: Vasu, a gifted animator with a troubled past, is forced to face his commitment issues when his partner Manu reveals her pregnancy.

title: The Task
overview: A chilling murder, a young witness, and two unlikely heroes pulled into a perilous game. With a ruthless mafia closing in, they embark on a daring mission to protect the innocent and hunt down those responsible. This action-packed thriller delivers tension, courage and nonstop excitement from start to finish.

title: Counting Crows: Have You Seen Me Lately?
overview: An intimate documentary chronicling the rise of the band Counting Crows and the unrelenting pressure that followed their breakout success. Centered on frontman Adam Duritz, the film explores the emotional aftermath of the band’s landmark studio album debut “August and Everything After” and the pressures and creative process of making their follow-up album “Recovering the Satellites.”

title: Schumacher '94: The Birth of a Legend
overview: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

title: Hijacked
overview: When a group of ruthless hijackers take control of a flight and try to force their way into the cockpit, an aviation security officer must find a way to fight back while still safely protect the passengers.

title: Love Imagined
overview: Youssef, an introverted university professor, tries to live a quiet and secluded life, but the arrival of the student Warda into his world turns everything upside down. while she is trying to mend her relationship with her boyfriend, Noah, Youssef finds himself gradually becoming entangled in their relationship.  As illusions intertwine with reality at the heart of a complicated love triangle, feelings he thought had long faded awaken within him.

title: Lakshmikanthan Kolai Vazhakku
overview: A young man convicted of murder awaits execution, while a conflicted judge, an aging hangman, and a morally torn jailer confront the weight of justice, guilt, and humanity in the final hours before dawn.

title: Yamla
overview: A young heir in Amritsar must choose between running his father's business empire and pursuing his passion for music, as tradition and dreams collide in Punjab's vibrant streets.

title: Departures
overview: It’s instant chemistry when Benji encounters Jake at an airport departures gate. Their on-going relationship unfolds through intimate trips to Amsterdam, revealing a complex power dynamic.

title: Ballerina Assassin
overview: After a devastating betrayal wipes out her entire spy network, an elite female assassin embarks on a relentless mission to dismantle the syndicate responsible.

title: Sharon & Ozzy Osbourne: Coming Home
overview: Follow the final three years of Ozzy Osbourne's life as he and Sharon plan a return home after 25 years in LA and prepare for the ultimate farewell gig.

title: Tormento
overview: An exhausted security guard is transferred to a morgue and, on their first night, discovers that the shadows and silences hide a torment from which there may be no return.

title: The Calling Witch
overview: A brother and sister are terrorized by what seems to be their late-author mother's most sinister literary creation - The Calling Witch.

title: Dusshera
overview: In Gujarat's Dang forests, Vaghmata, a wish-granting goddess, disappears after a 1999 tragedy. Tantric Rahu seeks her power while Devbapu and Officer Purohit defend their village from him and his Vetal.

title: Thomas Müller: One of a Kind
overview: Title collector, popular figure, advertising icon, and the face of German football – that's how we know Thomas Müller. But who is the person behind the superstar? We accompany Thomas Müller over a season before he departs from the national team and experience him with his loved ones: honest, authentic, and quick-witted - one of a kind!

title: By Design
overview: A woman swaps bodies with a chair, and everyone likes her better as a chair.

title: Pig Hill
overview: Carrie has been fascinated by the local legend of the pig people of Pig Hill, revolting creatures who breed and cause havoc in the area. As the tenth woman goes missing, Carrie can't stop thinking that there could be more to these stories.

title: Karol G: Tomorrow was Beautiful
overview: Karol G pulls back the curtain on her rise to stardom while navigating a sold-out stadium tour, creating new music and releasing a new album.

title: A Girl Named Willow
overview: What could Willow do with an entire forest? That's exactly what she asks herself when she inherits this forest from her aunt Alwina. That's not all, though - Alwina has also left her a small, crooked cabin and, most importantly, her witchcraft. But the question remains: Will Willow even accept this unexpected inheritance, with all the consequences it entails?

title: The Unknown
overview: David Zimmerman, almost 40, is a photographer but no one knows it. When friends drag him to a wild party, he spots a woman in the crowd and can’t take his eyes off her, he follows her… A few hours later, David wakes up: he’s in the body of the unknown woman.

title: Betray: Thirst
overview: Jamal Wiggins is a lawyer at Tate and Wiggins, the law firm he co-founded with his college roommate and friend, Darren Tate. While he enjoys professional success, his personal life is strained by a sexless marriage to Shavonne, his wife of 15 years. He takes on a case representing Jada Campbell, whose husband was involved in a life-altering accident. Jada, a victim of verbal and emotional abuse from her husband, develops feelings for Jamal. He, in turn, succumbs to temptation and crosses a professional boundary, soon realizing his world may be on the verge of collapse.

title: Don't Forget Me
overview: "Don't Forget Me" follows the emotional journey of Baran, a Kurdish-American journalist captured by ISIS who escapes to freedom alongside other female prisoners.

title: Cactus
overview: A Truck-Driver and a Prostitute are in love but the events unfolding at grass-root politics of region forces them to run and fight for their survival.

title: Organ Child
overview: A series of tragic events unfolds after Chang Chi-Mao's daughter goes missing as an infant. Chang becomes consumed by revenge against a powerful criminal organization suspected of kidnapping her. Along the way, he clings to the hope that his daughter may still be alive, determined to rescue her and break free from their dark fate.

title: Can You Feel the Beat: The Lisa Lisa Story
overview: 15-year-old Puerto Rican Lisa Velez overcomes sexism, racism, and breast cancer to become Latin pop pioneer behind hits like "Can You Feel The Beat," inspiring generations of Latina artists.

title: Flintoff
overview: Looks back at Andrew 'Freddie' Flintoff’s incredible life and cricketing career that saw him win two Ashes series with England and become a national sporting hero, whilst charting his life today and return to cricket following his life-altering car crash in 2022.

title: Rockstar
overview: Agun overcomes his childhood stage fright to become a world-famous rockstar. But with fame comes addiction, heartbreak, imprisonment, and the devastating loss of his voice. Supported by Aslam's friendship and Meera's love, he struggles to rebuild his life, only to be shattered once again by another tragic incident.

title: Detective Teekshana
overview: Every husband has detective wife. A proper detective role has become super at every stage.

title: The Dam
overview: The film takes place during the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine. After the Kakhovka dam is blown up, a detachment of Ukrainian soldiers led by a female fighter with the call sign Mara finds themselves in a secret Soviet bunker at the bottom of a reservoir where the USSR conducted human experiments during the Cold War. The consequences of these experiments are still in the bunker in the form of the half-living corpses of Soviet soldiers. Now, in order to survive, Ukrainians need to defeat the Soviet zombies, their own fear, as well as overcome internal disputes and trust each other.

title: Drunken Woman
overview: On the verge of childbirth, Li Qing is taken to a secluded villa in the suburbs to rest and await delivery. However, behind the seemingly meticulous care, she falls into an elaborately orchestrated, shocking conspiracy.

title: Night Creatures
overview: After serving his prison sentence, Dylan wants to cut ties with his past. However, because of an outstanding debt, he is forced into a final break-in at the popular Brasserie Papillon. There he meets the mysterious Margot. Their meeting unintentionally puts each other's fate in their hands. But neither considers Tonio, Papillon's flamboyant waiter. Their paths cross during 1 dramatic night that will change their lives forever.

title: Black to the Future
overview: In the utmost secrecy, the first African space mission is preparing to take off! The crew, from Africa and its diaspora, is set to explore the planet "NARDAL", assessing its potential as a refuge for all Africans should Earth ever become uninhabitable. The problem is that the journey will be long. Very long. And in interstellar missions, the greatest unknown is whether the astronauts will be able to get along.

title: The Second Wind
overview: Inspired by two real-life athletes, this documentary follows four women who choose happiness through sport. Born from Indira’s personal journey, it explores relationships, healing from disease, resilience, and the courage to never give up—an offbeat, feel-good story of finding life again.

title: Taxila
overview: When Earth is obliterated, its shattered fragments and encoded legacy are cast across the stars. Light-years away, a barren world, Taxila, awakens as Earth’s remnants seed it with life, turning humanity’s end into the universe’s next beginning.

title: Fabula
overview: Small-town criminal Jos (55) has, to his great frustration, been completely sidelined. His daughter disrespects him, his wife doesn't trust him, and his friends laugh at him openly. As he scrambles to fix a drug deal that went catastrophically wrong, he desperately searches for an answer to the question: Who or what is punishing me!?

title: El Mal
overview: “El mal is basically a suspense story, where the audience senses that something disturbing is going to happen, but doesn't know how or when. But it also aims to get the viewer to question their own certainties, their capacity to love and to accept their own dark side.”

title: Maigret in Society
overview: Commissioner Maigret rushes to the Quai d’Orsay with Lieutenant Janvier. There, they find Mademoiselle Larrieu in a state of shock. That very morning, she discovered the bullet-riddled body of Mr. Berthier-Lagès, a renowned former ambassador whom she had served as a housekeeper for 46 years. While searching the victim's apartment, Maigret and Janvier uncover hundreds of letters. The diplomat had maintained a fifty-year-long love correspondence with a certain Princess of Vuynes, whose husband - by a strange coincidence - had died just a few days earlier. As he confronts the various members of the two families and the suspicious silence of Mademoiselle Larrieu, Maigret finds himself faced with surprise after surprise, watching his certainties crumble - until the solution to the mystery finally hits him in the face at the very last moment...

title: Faster
overview: A former racer returns to the sport through a racing academy, where she meets Will. As they fall for each other, they become rivals competing for the Formula 1 championship, forcing her to choose between love and victory.

title: Six Each
overview: A student in Canada faces charges in her husband's death after allegedly deceiving him for visa purposes, highlighting immigrant families' desperate pursuit of opportunities.

title: Mensaje en una botella
overview: A renowned sommelier finds a way to communicate with her past self in an attempt to correct the mistakes that have shaped her life. However, each message sent triggers unexpected consequences, altering not only her present but also the fates of those around her. What begins as an opportunity to make amends for the past becomes a race against time to prevent everything from spiraling out of control.

title: Look Back
overview: The overly confident Fujino and the shut-in Kyomoto couldn’t be more different, but a love of drawing manga brings these two small-town girls together.

title: Kommersant
overview: Two up-and-coming friends, seeing themselves as the future elite of the new world, oligarchs, they sign up for a major deal, but it turns out that they have been drawn into a massive embezzlement scheme involving billions from the treasury. After his arrest, Andrei ends up in an overcrowded communal cell, a purgatory where he must transform himself into a different person in order to survive and return back to the real world, to his family.

title: Wild Sing
overview: Twenty years after a scandal tears apart a popular 2000s K‑pop trio, the three reunite for a one-off gig — if they can overcome one snag after another.

title: Kayara
overview: A courageous and athletic teenager, Kayara dreams that she is destined to be the first female to break into the league of Chasquis - the official messengers of the Incan empire. As she learns what it takes to be a Chasqui along with its challenges, she tackles every mission she gets and discovers the ancient stories of her land and her people.

title: The Drift
overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

title: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
overview: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

title: The Dresden Sun
overview: A brilliant, principled mercenary with a traumatic past works with an insider to steal a valued asset from Peredor Corporation called “the sphere”. The C & Earth corporation, vying for global dominance, seeks to find a solution to an otherworldly technology via a scientist’s project. Meanwhile, a financial analyst, who despises his job at the powerful investment firm Mutual One, finds himself caught between deadly corporate rivals, financial fraud, and technological espionage, and is ultimately forced to run from a psychopathic military contractor.

title: A Night Like This
overview: A stone-broke gay actor and a privileged screw-up with a failing business cross paths on a winter night and join forces in a quest around London to find a meaning to their miserable lives, but when their unlikely connection turns into something deeper, fears and demons from their past come to jeopardise the whole mission.

title: The Days Ahead
overview: The Days Ahead is a present day nuclear attack drama anthology presenting three distinct stories showing how characters with varying degrees of preparedness cope with an attack on the United Kingdom.

title: Forbidden Fairytale
overview: An aspiring children's book writer agrees to write erotic web novels to pay her car repair debt – with unintended consequences for her coworker.

title: Warden
overview: A docu-style science fiction thriller exploring the real-world impact of a young man discovering his superpowers. It delves into how his presence influences society, attracting followers, sparking conflict, and changing the lives of everyone around him.

title: Gangland
overview: A weathered tribal cop and his new trainee must find a ruthless fugitive, whose return to their rural Indigenous reservation has exposed its darkest secrets and could ignite a violent gang war.

title: Once Upon a Time in Gaza
overview: In 2007, Yahya works at his friend Osama’s falafel shop in Gaza, which doubles as a drug dealing front. His entanglement leads him to witness a terrible crime. A couple years later, Gaza’s Ministry of Culture randomly chooses Yahya to star in a TV series that highlights martyrs and heroes of the resistance. As conflict simmers in the distance, Yahya unexpectedly receives real weapons, heightening the stakes as the show provides him with an opportunity to confront the perpetrator of the offense that changed his life.

title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
overview: A poetic, emotionally expansive father-son story about Black family, grace, imagination, and the hope that love can transform even the most fragile relationships into something more healing and beautiful.

title: Beware Boiúna
overview: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

title: Don't Move
overview: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

title: The Musical
overview: Doug, a frustrated playwright and middle school theater teacher, learns his ex is dating his nemesis, the school principal. To get revenge and cost him a Blue Ribbon Award, Doug secretly stages the most inappropriate play imaginable.

title: Charlie Harper
overview: The journey of two young souls, Charlie and Harper, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

title: Family
overview: A 10-year-old girl begins to believe her parents are trying to kill her. Convinced a sinister spirit is to blame, she spirals into a haunting fantasy world that mirrors her deepest fears.

title: Rolling Loud
overview: Desperate to reconnect with his 13-year-old son, Hank secretly takes him to Rolling Loud against his wife's wishes. When Zion disappears inside the massive festival, Hank teams with two unlikely allies and plunges into an increasingly insane search—while hiding the truth from his wife and confronting the harder truth that his son is growing up.
